notes.title: Update 1.0.0
notes.content:
Update changes:

[list]
[*] Simplified the kitchen main menu level, so it's now easier to navigate, and quicker to select your favourite game mode, level, variant and rounds per match.
[/list]
[list]
[*] Changed the UI to a cleaner/friendly look. 
[/list]
[list]
[*] Added up to 10 rounds per match, without the need to return to the kitchen/character selection every time you finished a round.
[/list]
[list]
[*] New podium "Final results" winning screen.
[/list]
[list]
[*] Created a new "Variants" option, to keep the rounds challenging, unpredictable and even crazier! 
[/list]
